description: What enemies drop, besides the Badass tiers (sheets/badass_tiers.json): the shares of guns, shields and relics, the creature drop rule and BL2's own odds for reference. source 'bl2' = read from the badass survey (tools/badass_report.py) or the shield survey; 'design' = a Skylands choice (the user's). See docs/badass-roadmap.md.

columns.bl2_object: the Borderlands 2 object it comes from ('-' none)
columns.read_verified: yes once read from a real BL2 install

rows.note: a creature's random item is a gun this often (BL2's enemy gear pool: weapons 44.44, shields 20.00, relics 8.89; grenade and class mods do not exist in Skylands, so the three are weighed against each other: gun 60 %, shield 27 %, relic 12 %)
a creature's random item is a shield this often (see gun_weight)
a creature's random item is a relic this often (BL2 artifacts; see gun_weight)
the user's rule: a creature drops at half a person's rate (people: gun 25 % + shield carry x 25 % + relic carry x 100 %); per class in sheets/enemy_stats.json drop_scale
a creature's chance never goes above this
for reference: how often a regular BL2 enemy drops a gun or gear item in single player (Skylands people drop more: the user's 25 % gun roll); not used
for reference and the 'named bosses with a unique drop' idea: BL2's chance that a boss drops its unique item; not used yet
single player, first playthrough: a champion (Badass) deals 0.74 where a regular enemy deals 0.65; it is folded into badass_tiers melee_damage_mult and gun_damage_mult
